reviews.title: I was literally sleeping and DREAMING during labour
reviews.contents:
I fell asleep to a track every night for the last two months of my pregnancy. It helped me relax and calm down at the end of the day. I also did the affirmations while I drove.

When labour time came, I recited the affirmations and used the relaxation techniques during contractions and in between. I was able to relax so quickly after a contraction that I was literally sleeping and dreaming. I could not have asked for a more peaceful labour! (I was in a pool btw)

The pushing tracks and imagery were not helpful to me, but other than that, I 10/10 recommend this app if you are in any way worried or anxious about labour and labour discomfort. I paid for this app when they offered me a discount and it was 100% worth my money.

reviews.title: A must for anxiety
reviews.contents: This became my crutch when I found out my baby was breech at 38 weeks. I did the meditations daily and it was very soothing for my nervous system. Now using it postpartum and love it

reviews.title: Better than HB
reviews.contents: I took the popular course in hypnotherapy and birthing but I found GentleBirthing possibly even more effective. I’m still using it several weeks postpartum and like it possibly more during this stage! Thanks for this!

reviews.title: Excellent tool!
reviews.contents: I am only just started with GentleBirth, but I am really enjoying the approach and various audio tracks to help with your mental stamina, perspective and general wellbeing. I would happily continue this well beyond the fourth trimester - a great personal improvement tool!

reviews.title: Issues with new update
reviews.contents: I’m not able to play any of the longer hypnosis tracks. Very annoying for a paid service.

reviews.title: An incredible app to help prepare for birth
reviews.contents: Mindset is so essential! As a RN and prenatal educator I send this app to all of my students to help prepare them mentally for their birth and postpartum experience. I am using it myself for this pregnancy as well and loving it!

reviews.title: Great app with lots of options
reviews.contents:
Great app with lots of
Options for Hypnobirthing,
Meditation, affirmations and more. Each day is new + allows for choice without repetition.

reviews.title: THE BEST APP
reviews.contents: This app has helped me mentally prepare and stay calm throughout my entire pregnancy. Using it so much more for my second baby after having a rough time the first time. Really helping me feel confident and at ease as I approach my due date. I listen to it every night to fall asleep as well. Cannot say enough wonderful things about it!!

reviews.title: Pelvic floor physio gives 5 stars
reviews.contents: As a pelvic floor physiotherapist, I highly recommend this app if it’s accessible to use during pregnancy, birth and the postpartum period!

reviews.title: Loving it!
reviews.contents: Gentle Birth is a fantastic user friendly tool for preparing for birth! I love the guided meditations, breathing, and Hypnobirthing exercises! Highly recommend!
